quest.title: Grow Up Quickly, Littl'Un
quest.description: At the Children of Echoes' tribal settlement, the archaeologist Tahmures and her assistant Akeor appear to have run into some trouble...

talks.objective: Listen to what Alem is saying

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's train her "observation" first.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Sounds good. Let's head to the training grounds then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...There are really training grounds?

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: ...*cough* Keep it down, would you? I busted my chops finding this place. Our tribe uses it for training anyway, it just happens to be undergoing maintenance recently.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: So though some mechanisms don't work... And others are partially dismantled... It's more than sufficient for training...

choices.text: Truly, your quick thinking is astounding.

response.speaker: Akeor
response.text: Sorry, sorry... *sigh* Look, this was the best I could do. It was hard enough to find a relatively safe spot as it is, and I don't have what it takes to give Alem a convincing demonstration...

response.speaker: Akeor
response.text: #Help us, {NICKNAME}, you're our only hope! Please, if only for Alem's sake.

response.speaker: Akeor
response.text: If we don't give her good advice and find something for her to do, she'll run off from the tribe herself, and then who knows what kinda crazy hijinks she'll get into?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Fine...

response.speaker: Akeor
response.text: Thank you so much! Phew... I can finally relax a bit...

response.speaker: Tahmures
response.text: #Okay! Let's head out sooner rather than later. Alem, you be sure to watch what {NICKNAME} does carefully, okay?

response.speaker: Alem
response.text: Got it!

response.speaker: Akeor
response.text: ...*sigh* I can't believe we're tricking a kid like this. Wayob, please do not blame me, I don't know what else we can do...

choices.text: Who but you could come up with such an incredible idea on the spot?

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Ahem! We're here! This is the training grounds for honing your "observation."

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: It may look all flat and unassuming, but there's a ton of explosive mechanisms buried underground.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: If you don't exercise good judgment and move too hastily, you might trigger one of them, and then boom! It'll rock you, and down to the ground you go.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Normally, we Children of Echoes use our Tepetlisaurus partners to help us excavate the target mechanisms while avoiding the obstacles.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: However, as archaeologists, we must consider all kinds of extreme circumstances.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: So... In this training, you can only rely on your powers of observation to find and excavate the buried targets.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: #Okay, next up, {NICKNAME} will demonstrate how to properly dig those mechanisms up!

talks.objective: Dig out the buried target mechanisms

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: Tahmures... Do you archaeologists really have to take tough classes like this?

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: That's a given! And this is nothing. Once you start formally studying, then you'll find out what "tough" really means...

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: You've got some serious skill... You dug up the buried mechanisms in no time flat, and not only that... Your clothes aren't even mussed up. You probably weren't ever even knocked over by the explosives.

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Thank goodness! We're so lucky to have run into someone as amazing as you...

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: Awesome!!! I wanna try too! Akeor, Akeor, let me, let me!

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: No need to be so hasty, Alem. We have to reset the field first. Once everything's ready, I'll bring you back here and walk you through it step by step.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: But before that, you have to stay with Tahmures and not run off, you hear?

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: I know, I know. I'll listen to her, and I definitely won't run off!

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: That's a good kid, Alem. Now come on over, I'll read you some articles related to archaeology. Make sure you pay attention...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: #Phew... Thank you so much for your help, {NICKNAME}. I don't know what we'd have done without you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could've just demonstrated yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Me? *sigh* Don't even joke about that. If I didn't dig those treasures up, I'm afraid I wouldn't even be able to guarantee Tahmures's safety.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: And I don't know when she plans to start her next archaeological dig... No, no, wait, if she finishes her expedition, then she'll return to Sumeru, and then...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Oh! I... Y—You didn't hear anything. Here's your reward, please, just hurry up and take it, no need to stand on ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Alright, I need to go set things up again. Ugh... What should I bury this time? Maybe I should just bury some Grainfruit...

talks.objective: Dig out the buried target mechanisms

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: Tahmures, how's my training coming? Can I be an archaeologist now?

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Yes, you're doing great, Alem! Once you've got things down, I can start teaching you the formal courses!

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Tahmures has specially prepared a bunch of resources for you. Once the training is over, be sure to study hard, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're here, and just in time! Alem, get ready to go train with your mentor, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's train her "endurance" first.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Sounds good. Let's head to the training grounds then.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Ahem! We're here! This is the training grounds for improving your "endurance."

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Er... Our tribe actually invited the Scions of the Canopy to come and make some special modifications to the grounds.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Put simply, this training is all about reaching the finish line as fast as you can, any way you can!

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: #Okay, next up, {NICKNAME} will demonstrate how to get to the finish line super quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's train her "observation" today.

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: I'm all set!

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: You seem to have gotten out on the right side of the bed, Alem! Let's head to the training grounds now.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After a short while, Tahmures and the others emerge from the path to the side...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: How do you run so fast? We took shortcuts and still couldn't keep up with you!

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Thank goodness! We're so lucky to have run into someone as amazing as you...

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: I get it now, so can I start running? I'm all ready!

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Hold on now, Alem. No need to rush. Akeor still needs to make some adjustments to the course. So that... it'll be more suitable for you to really shine.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: So before that, you need to stay with Tahmures, and no matter what, do not run off, or jump the gun.

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: I know, I know. I'll listen, and I definitely won't start the run early!

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Alem, you're such a sweet kid. Come here now, let me see to your clothes, and make sure they don't trip you up halfway through...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: #Phew... Thank you so much for your help, {NICKNAME}. I don't know what we'd have done without you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could've just demonstrated yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Me? Don't even joke about that. Without my Saurian companion, and just under my own power? My legs can't carry me that fast.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I could dig up some more treasures. But I don't even know when Tahmures plans to start her next archaeological dig...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: No, no, wait, if she finishes her expedition, then she'll return to Sumeru, and then...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Oh! I... Y—You didn't hear anything. Here's your reward, please, just hurry up and take it, no need to stand on ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Alright, I need to go set things up again. Ugh... What should I set up this time?

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: Tahmures! I wanna be an archaeologist too!

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Now there, Alem, being an archaeologist means more than just running around digging up rocks. It requires a whole lot of study, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: But, but... archaeologists get to play with baby Saurians! Mama won't even let me find my own Saurian!

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Alem, didn't your mother already say that she'd talk about it once you were grown up?

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: But I'm growing up right now! And you said that the only growing up that matters is your brain growing up!

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: So if I learn all kinds of stuff from you, then I'll grow up faster! You said so yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: That... is what I said. Hahaha... You're actually pretty sharp...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Tahmures... what should we do...

response.speaker: Tahmures
response.text: As for us... Ahem... Alem, I did indeed say that, and I didn't lie to you either.

response.speaker: Tahmures
response.text: But before you can officially start studying archaeology and taking related courses, you must... um... there's, uh... pre-class... pre-class training you have to take.

response.speaker: Tahmures
response.text: #And this good {M#lad}{F#lass} is the... um, mentor we hired, just to train you!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #Hi, I'm {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Alem
response.text: Hooray!

response.speaker: Tahmures
response.text: ...Sorry about this, but could you play along for a bit? Please, it's important, I'll definitely pay you back.

choices.text: I happen to be a very strict teacher.

response.speaker: Alem
response.text: I'm not scared! We Children of Echoes are tougher than rocks!

response.speaker: Tahmures
response.text: Okay! Now let's familiarize you with the curriculum... Akeor, you're up.

response.speaker: Akeor
response.text: M—Me? I'm supposed to introduce the... Um... Alem, as you know, all those brave warriors in the tribe have all received "observation" and "endurance" training.

response.speaker: Akeor
response.text: As an archaeologist who will frequently venture into dangerous environs, you too must possess such qualities.

response.speaker: Alem
response.text: I'll do my best!

response.speaker: Akeor
response.text: Very well then. Now, let's leave it up to your mentor which pre-class training to do first.

choices.text: And how should you greet your teacher?

response.speaker: Alem
response.text: Hello, Teacher! Nice to meet you!

choices.text: I wanna be an archaeologist too!

response.speaker: Akeor
response.text: And you, friend... You needn't do any more growing up. You look plenty mature already.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Wayob forgive me, Wayob have mercy, we have no evil intentions... These mechanisms will knock someone over at most, and will never seriously injure anyone... Wayob, forgive me, Wayob, have mercy...

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: I'm all set, Akeor!

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: You little scamp, now you're the one rushing me... Look, I'll go set up the grounds right away, so just hold your horses, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Your skills are just as incredible as ever... You dug up all the mechanisms just like that.

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Perhaps it's only because she has such an amazing example to follow in you that she's so enthusiastic about training.

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: ...Seeing how motivated she is, I can't help but think that she might really become an outstanding archaeologist.

choices.text: Haven't you already prepped a bunch of study materials?

response.speaker: Tahmures
response.text: Oh, those! Just some of my notes and things I've learned over the years, along with a bunch of random stories.

response.speaker: Tahmures
response.text: I never imagined she'd actually get through it all.

response.speaker: Tahmures
response.text: Anyway, this is for you. Please, take it. I'll go prepare some more study materials for Alem in a bit.

response.speaker: Tahmures
response.text: Before I leave Natlan, I'll be sure to teach her everything I can.

response.speaker: Tahmures
response.text: Hehe... I hope that a new star of archaeology will rise up from Natlan.

choices.text: Are you going to take nurturing her seriously now?

response.speaker: Tahmures
response.text: "Nurture" might be a bit of a strong word. With my qualifications, at most, all I can do is give her a primer in archaeology.

response.speaker: Tahmures
response.text: If I were to try and teach her any more than that, I'd probably end up hampering her progress...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's train her "endurance" today.

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: I'm all set!

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: You seem to have gotten out on the right side of the bed, Alem! Let's head to the training grounds now.

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: Tahmures, I already finished the book you gave me last time, and took some notes too! See?

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Oh... Oh! These notes are... really not bad at all.

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: Yeah! Because just like you said, I have to study hard if I wanna be an archaeologist.

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: ...I see.

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Alem, I believe that you'll become the best archaeologist there is.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Just like last time, there's a bunch of buried mechanisms.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Since Alem's already pretty good, I... upped the difficulty a bit, and buried even more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...You buried new mechanisms?

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: ...Shh, keep your voice down! It's just we didn't finish dismantling all the explosives from last time, did we...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: #Anyway, {NICKNAME}, I'll leave the demo to you. I'm sure they won't pose a problem for you.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Alem... Is she actually serious about all this...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: We're here! This is the training grounds for improving your "endurance."

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Just like before, it's all about reaching the finish line as fast as you can, any way you can!

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, I'll leave the demonstration to you. Show us what you've got.

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: I'm the best at running! I'm so fast, that sometimes not even Mama can catch me!

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Wait, wait a second, Alem! We should watch the demonstration first. Remember, patience is an important virtue for archaeologists!

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: Oh... fine, but afterward, I wanna be the first to run!

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: Tahmures, I don't quite understand the notes you gave me before...

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Let me see... Huh? This... This question...

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: So, can you explain it to me in detail?

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Eh!? Hahaha... Sure, just wait a second, let me piece my thoughts together first...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Wayob forgive me, Wayob have mercy, we have no evil intentions...

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Alem... Is she actually serious about all this...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After a short while, Tahmures and the others emerge from the path to the side...

dialogues.speaker: Alem
dialogues.text: I kinda think... I can just go for it. No need to adjust anything, Akeor.

dialogues.speaker: Akeor
dialogues.text: Pfft, you little scamp, why're you in such a hurry? Let me clean up those sticks and rocks in the way. Haven't you thought of what would happen if you tripped?

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: You're just too fast... I think that no matter what kind of shortcut we take, we just can't keep up with you.

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: Perhaps it's only because she has such an amazing example to follow in you that she's so enthusiastic about training.
